about.intro: I'm a *Fullstack Web Developer* focused on building **clean, responsive, and maintainable** web applications.
about.description: Fifth-semester Informatics undergraduate at UPN "Veteran" Jawa Timur with over 1.5 years of hands-on, project-based experience in fullstack web development. Skilled in PHP, Laravel, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and MySQL. Currently expanding my frontend skills with React and Vite.
about.full:
Hi, I'm **Brian Dicky Vanka Andaraneva** — a Fullstack Web Developer based in Sidoarjo, East Java.

Fifth-semester Informatics undergraduate at **UPN "Veteran" Jawa Timur** with over 1.5 years of hands-on, project-based experience in fullstack web development. Skilled in backend development with **PHP and Laravel**, and frontend development with **HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript**, with practical experience in MySQL-backed MVC architecture, CRUD operations, and frontend–backend integration.

Currently working as a Fullstack Developer at Javatekno Mitra Solusi, building the Pusat Kos web application in Laravel, and reinforcing these skills through Coding Camp project work and independent projects in inventory management and desktop application development, while currently expanding frontend development skills with **React** and **Vite**.

projects.title: PUSATKOS
projects.description: Currently in Development / Ongoing. Built the owner and customer web flows of a Laravel 12 kos-rental platform, implementing MVC controllers, Eloquent models, routes, and Blade views based on a converted frontend template. Pages and forms currently run on structured dummy data from each controller, with database migrations, authentication, and live CRUD as the next milestones.

projects.title: PULSE
projects.description: Built a personal inventory management web application for restaurant/F&B operations, implementing CRUD-based stock, supplier, usage, and waste tracking with search, filtering, sorting, and CSV export. Implemented a KPI dashboard with stock movement visualization, automatic notifications, and confirmation dialogs, using localStorage/sessionStorage for browser-based data persistence.

projects.title: Kopi Nusantara
projects.description: Developed a multi-page responsive website for an Indonesian coffee brand, including Home, Product, Gallery, About, Order, and Contact pages. Built a responsive navbar with active-link highlighting using vanilla JavaScript, styled with Bootstrap 5 and custom CSS.

projects.title: Vehicle Tax
projects.description: Built a desktop application implementing object-oriented PKB and SWDKLLJ tax calculation with owner and vehicle data management, using Java Swing and C++ Qt. Implemented automatic tax calculation with result breakdown, transaction history, and search, edit, and delete functionality, with file-based persistence on the Qt version.

projects.title: SIPEMMA
projects.description: Built an integrated Point of Sale (POS) and restaurant management web application using Laravel 13 and Tailwind CSS v4. Features an interactive cashier workflow with real-time cart, category tabs, Dine In and Take Away order handling, automatic 10% PB1 tax calculation, digital receipt generation, menu CRUD with stock tracking, a comprehensive sales analytics KPI dashboard, and an integrated AI assistant powered by Google Gemini (gemini-3.6-flash) for business analytics and strategic insights.

projects.title: Nalar
projects.description: Developed an AI-powered personalized learning companion web application designed to help university students master academic subjects deeply. Built with Next.js (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion. Features a modern landing page and interactive study workspace that extracts lecture PDFs, identifies conceptual comprehension weaknesses, and delivers adaptive private-tutor guidance.

description: Participating in an industry-oriented, project-based learning program focused on full-stack web development and AI integration.
Developing skills across frontend, backend, React, JavaScript, AI, and web application development through structured learning and hands-on projects.
Developing a Laravel and PHP-based web application for Pusat Kos, working across frontend and backend components.
Structuring the application's MVC layer (controllers, Eloquent models, Blade views) in a local XAMPP environment, in preparation for MySQL database integration and live CRUD functionality.

experience.company: Dicoding (Coding Camp powered by DBS Foundation)
description: Developed a fullstack web application featuring 3 CRUD-based modules with complete data lifecycle management (create, read, update, delete).
Implemented frontend-backend integration with database connectivity in a project-based engineering environment.
